title: Vietnamese Stir-Fried Herbs with Fried Air (Gluten-Free)
description: A unique and flavorful dish that combines fresh herbs with crispy fried air, all in a gluten-free format.

ingredients.name: Fried Air
ingredients.notes: use a deep fryer or a pot with oil

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the fresh herbs to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of vegetable oil to the pan and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the fried air to the pan and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until combined with the herbs.
